patch.summary: Is Bolt for Business worth it? Bolt for Business is a corporate ground-transport account for teams — employees book rides via the Bolt app under company billing, with ride history, limits, and admin controls. Pricing is usage-based per trip (2026-08-19), not a traditional per-seat HR SaaS s…. Strong when Teams needing employee ride-hailing with central billing. Weak when Mobility-only — not HRIS or T&E suite.
